# Appwrite Web SDK 29.1.0

Unmodified browser ES modules from https://sdk.appwrite.io/web/29.1.0/:
`client.js`, `account.js`, `storage.js`, `id.js`, `chunks/query-CfsOKCEq.js`.
Only the Client, Account and Storage dependency graphs are included. License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE).
Served locally to preserve GitHub Pages subpath and offline operation without a build step
or a runtime dependency on a CDN. Source map comments refer to upstream maps, not included.
